title: Symbolic Music Generation with Non-Differentiable Rule Guided Diffusion

layout.note: A top row of two rounded boxes (Rule Programs left, Pretrained Diffusion Model right) and, below, one large rounded box titled Stochastic Control Guidance (SCG). A translucent light-blue wedge widens from the junction under the top boxes to the title of the large box. Inside it a left-to-right pipeline has three parallel candidate rows that converge on a single Rules box and a loss bar glyph, ending in the selected candidate.

lesson: Zoom from a short overview chain into one step with a translucent wedge; in the zoom fan one state into parallel candidate rows through the same checker, show the comparison as a bar glyph, and mark the winner with a colour switch and a smiley that carries on to the next state.
